name: Repton Boxing Club
title: Repton Boxing Club: The UK's Oldest Amateur Boxing Club, Bethnal Green, Est. 1884
description: Amateur boxing club in a Victorian bath house on Cheshire Street, Bethnal Green, since 1971. Founded 1884. Juniors, seniors and a Saturday nursery.

sections.title: Walk in. Work hard. Belong.
sections.text: Widely regarded as the oldest amateur boxing club in the UK, training East End kids and adults in a Victorian bath house since 1971.

sections.title: 140 years of East End boxing.
paragraphs: Repton was founded in 1884 by Repton School to support boys in the East End. Boxing was on the top floor of a Bethnal Green townhouse, next to chess, whist and bagatelle.

After homes in Victoria Park Square and Pollard Row, the club moved into a former Victorian bath house on Cheshire Street in 1971. It has trained there ever since, producing Olympic gold medallists and world title holders.
